useCases.title: What Can You Build with NuxFire?
useCases.subtitle: Most SaaS boilerplates break the moment you need stateful WebSockets, async job queues, or true enterprise multi-tenancy. NuxFire is engineered to carry your project from day-one MVP all the way to millions of daily requests without refactoring your core architecture.

b2b.title: B2B SaaS & Team Workspaces
b2b.description: Sell subscription tiers with per-seat or workspace billing. Strict tenant isolation, tokenized team invitations, and fine-grained role-based access control (RBAC) are fully audited and production-ready on day one.
b2b.superpower: Native teams layer, nuxt-authorization, Stripe Checkout/Portal, and integrated Kanban layer.

realtime.title: Stateful Realtime Applications
realtime.description: Build multiplayer collaborative apps without expensive Redis clusters or dedicated Socket.io servers. Each room or channel operates in an isolated Cloudflare Durable Object backed by low-latency embedded SQLite.
realtime.superpower: Durable Objects with SQLite storage, HMAC-signed ticket handshake, and sub-50ms global edge latency.

ai.title: AI Platforms & Autonomous Agents
ai.description: Execute long-running LLM completions and heavy compute without blocking the UI or hitting HTTP request timeouts. Cloudflare Queues process async jobs with exponential backoff and Dead Letter Queue capture.
ai.superpower: Cloudflare Queues with DLQ, unlimited R2 storage with zero egress fees, and live updates via WebSockets.

micro.title: Micro-SaaS & Membership Portals
micro.description: Ship lean, highly profitable subscription tools in a single weekend. OpenAuth.js authentication runs in Cloudflare KV with zero database connection overhead, and Nuxt Content v3 provides lightning-fast documentation and blogs.
micro.superpower: OpenAuth with zero-DB sessions, D1 SQL Full-Text Search, and pre-configured Stripe Billing.

enterprise.title: Client Portals & Internal Backoffices
enterprise.description: Deliver self-service portals and operational backoffices that pass stringent corporate security audits. Comes standard with a dedicated Super-Admin console, TOTP Multi-Factor Authentication, and full audit logging.
enterprise.superpower: Isolated /admin portal with TOTP MFA, audit_logs table in PostgreSQL, and end-to-end type safety.

api.title: High-Scale APIs & Event Pipelines
api.description: Process millions of webhooks and background jobs with near-zero idle infrastructure cost. Hyperdrive connection pooling accelerates PostgreSQL queries without connection exhaustion, and transactional emails handle failovers.
api.superpower: Cloudflare Hyperdrive TCP connection pooling, multi-provider React Email (Resend/Brevo/SES), and edge Crons.

item1.question: How do I access and get started with NuxFire?
item1.answer:
Immediately after purchasing, you receive instant access to download the complete source code directly inside your exclusive Members Area. There is zero waiting for manual repository invites or access approvals.

The codebase comes complete with a 5-minute quickstart guide, setup scripts, and step-by-step Cloudflare deployment documentation so you can ship your SaaS to production on day one.

item2.question: Can I test the live demo before purchasing?
item2.answer:
Yes! This entire live application is running the exact same production-grade monorepo codebase that you receive upon purchase.

Create a test account to experience the OpenAuth authentication, team workspaces, invite flows, granular RBAC permissions, and the platform admin console. What you see and test here is exactly what you will own and deploy.

item3.question: What technical stack and experience do I need?
item3.answer:
NuxFire is built with modern TypeScript, Nuxt 4, Vue 3, and declarative SST v4 for Cloudflare.

• For Senior Developers: You get clean modular layers, end-to-end type safety with tRPC, and Drizzle ORM—with zero vendor lock-in and zero runtime framework bloat.
• For AI Builders & Vibe Coders: If you build using Cursor, Claude Code, or v0, NuxFire provides the ultimate architectural context. Strict TypeScript contracts, typed schemas, and isolated Nuxt Layers allow AI models to generate reliable, production-ready features on the first attempt without breaking existing logic.

item4.question: How customizable is the starter kit?
item4.answer:
NuxFire provides 100% full source code ownership. You receive the raw, unminified code without proprietary CLI wrappers, hidden npm packages, or black-box dependencies.

• Freely customize or rebrand the entire Tailwind CSS design system and tokens.
• Add, modify, or remove modular layers (admin, billing, teams, notifications, kanban).
• Extend the Drizzle ORM database schema and generate migrations automatically.
• Implement your own custom business logic with full architectural freedom.

item5.question: What support and community do I get?
item5.answer:
Every license includes:

• Complete, searchable documentation covering architecture, secrets, and Cloudflare configuration.
• Detailed walkthrough guides for local development, migrations, and deployment.
• Direct access to our Discord community for collaboration and troubleshooting.
• Dedicated email assistance for setup and onboarding questions.

item6.question: Do I receive updates and new features?
item6.answer:
Yes! Your license includes lifetime access to all future updates, security patches, framework upgrades, and new architectural layers directly in your Members Area.

Whenever Nuxt, Cloudflare Workers, or SST release major improvements, we update the starter kit so your foundation remains modern and battle-tested at no additional cost.

item7.question: Can I build commercial SaaS projects with this license?
item7.answer:
Yes! The license gives you perpetual rights to build unlimited commercial SaaS products, internal tools, and client projects.

• Use the codebase across unlimited domains and client projects.
• Collect 100% of your customer subscription revenue with zero royalties.
• Pay once with lifetime ownership—there are never any monthly code subscription fees.

Review the license documentation for full terms and conditions.
